note: Notes on decided verdicts, kept outside the hashed hypothesis files: a recorded verdict is never edited, only annotated. A VOID verdict stays on record in its file; the only way to run that idea again is a new registration with a new id that counts the void run's trials in prior_trials (docs/research/edge-hunt.md, rule 8).

annotations.reason: The REJECT was decided on 0 trades in train and validation: a data bug, not a test of the idea. The F&O stock bhavcopies before July 2024 carry no underlying price and the event-vol engine (revision 1) took the spot only from them, so no at-the-money iron fly existed on any results day from 2012 to mid-2024. Fixed in #88 (event-vol revision 2: spot from the stock's equity close, else the near future); #90 added the dated lot sizes those boards also lack.

evidence.gates_failed_because_empty: 8 of 10 gates failed on an empty run (0 trades, deflated Sharpe not measured, PBO 1.0); the 2 that passed (drawdown 0%, span) pass trivially on no trades.
